AtomicSystem.from_pubchem#

classmethod AtomicSystem.from_pubchem()#

Explore and load a molecule from PubChem.

Returns:
AtomicSystem or None

The selected molecule, or None if cancelled.

Examples

>>> molecule = AtomicSystem.from_pubchem()
